displayPattern: Status LED: 3 short flash(es) then 3 long flash(es) (code 33)
meaning: Limit circuit fault: a limit or flame rollout switch is open. Becomes lockout 13 if open longer than 3 minutes.
causes: Dirty filter or restricted duct system
Restricted vent or improper vent sizing
Inadequate combustion air supply (flame rollout switch open)
diySteps: Turn off power and check/replace a dirty air filter
Make sure return and supply grilles are open and unobstructed
Technician: check blower, venting, gas input and switches; flame rollout switch requires manual reset after the cause is corrected
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: if the code returns after a filter change, or if the rollout switch tripped.
